name: ModWorkshop
what_it_is: A community platform for sharing and downloading mods for various games, with PAYDAY 2 as its origin.
platforms: Web; hosts mods for PAYDAY 2, PAYDAY: The Heist, Noita, Crime Boss and other games.
pricing: No prices are shown; downloads need no account, and the site says it does not throttle downloads.
notable: The impressum names Sidetrack Games B.V. in Amsterdam as the operator; the About page says the site is open source and moderators are volunteers.

facts.fact: ModWorkshop describes itself as a platform for sharing and downloading mods for various games, hosting PAYDAY 2, PAYDAY: The Heist, Noita and Crime Boss.
ModWorkshop states that downloading mods needs no account, that downloads are not throttled, and that its moderators are volunteers.
The site says it joined Sidetrack Games and released an official PAYDAY 2 in-game mod browser.
The legal notice names Sidetrack Games B.V., Amsterdam, as the operator of the site.

name: Tebex
what_it_is: A game monetization provider offering webstores, checkout and store protection, acting as merchant of record.
platforms: Web; in-game and in-app integrations, per the vendor.
pricing: Prices are not shown on the home or About page; the vendor offers 'Talk to sales' and an account sign-up.
notable: Vendor claims 130+ payment methods, 70+ countries and 45K+ businesses; its About page says it runs tens of thousands of webstores for GTA5's user-generated economy (testimonial).

facts.fact: Tebex says it acts as merchant of record, handling fraud, compliance and chargebacks, and lists webstores, checkout and store protection as products.
The vendor states 130+ payment methods, 70+ countries and 45K+ businesses monetizing, with $1.5B processed so far.
A testimonial on the About page says Tebex runs tens of thousands of web shops for GTA5's user-generated content economy.
The home page offers a 'Talk to sales' route and an account opening for server owners, with no prices shown.

name: Minecraft Marketplace
what_it_is: The official Minecraft storefront where approved partners sell add-ons such as skins, maps and texture packs.
pricing: Prices are not shown on the creator page; it points to a partner program and a Marketplace Pass.
notable: Selling requires becoming an official Minecraft partner.

facts.fact: Minecraft's creator page says creators can learn to make add-ons such as skins, maps and texture packs, become a Partner and sell them in the Marketplace.
The creator page links to a Marketplace Pass, best sellers, a Creator Learning Portal and Bedrock Edition creator documentation.
The creator page links to a Minecraft Partners section about what it takes to become an official partner.
